display.title: Episode 218: I Love Hashem (Purim)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's Purim night show: the Purim Merrymakers land in Studio 604 by helicopter, a guest sings Purim songs with graggers, and a boy learns from a mirror why we serve Hashem with joy.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Purim night. Every time Uncle Yossi tries to open the program, he is drowned out by strange noises and laughter, until a helicopter lands in Studio 604 and the Purim Merrymakers, little soldiers of Tzivos Hashem, march out to remind everyone that on Purim it is a mitzvah to be happy. Listeners get their graggers ready while a guest singer performs Purim songs, with everyone drowning out Haman's name. Uncle Yossi recalls how Mordechai gathered Jewish children to learn Torah, whose pure voices helped annul Haman's decree, and a young girl recites the Shema. After a sponsor message, story time: Beryl comes home and asks his mother for a large mirror. His teacher taught, following the Baal Shem Tov, that we can learn from everything: a mirror shows a happy face back to a happy face, so if we serve Hashem with joy, Hashem shines joy back to us. We are happy because we have a neshamah, because we have the Torah and mitzvos, and because they bring us close to Hashem. Beryl then sings the song 'I Love Hashem'.
display.lesson: Serve Hashem with joy: we have a neshamah, the Torah and mitzvos, and every mitzvah brings us closer to Hashem.

date.note: Purim night program; episode 217 announced it for 'Purim night, next Tuesday' after Taanis Esther on Monday, March 24. Matches the weekly estimate.

privacy.note: Shema guest named in full; a guest singer is also named.

sources_cited.note: Mordechai gathered Jewish children to learn Torah, which annulled Haman's decree (attributed on air to the Megillah).
The Baal Shem Tov: learn a lesson in serving Hashem from everything you see or hear.
